references.text: Highlights the continuity in family structure: Joseph presents his sons to Jacob (Gen 48:13), and later he himself sees his great-grandchildren in the same way (50:23).
Narrative parallel showing the life cycle: Joseph brings his sons to his grandfather (Gen 48:1), and later sees his own great-grandchildren (50:23).
The blessing over Ephraim and Manasseh (Gen 48:14) leads directly to the large family Joseph sees in the third generation (50:23).
